verdicts.reason: A: the flavour pills are blown up so much that the full-width HONEY ROSEMARY pill is bigger and heavier than the Shop Flavours CTA, which breaks the hierarchy. Its pill stack is also cramped against the bottom edge, and the CTA sits right-floated and doesn't line up with the left-aligned text. B: the headline wraps better and the pills are smaller than the CTA, so the hierarchy holds better. But it has the same problems: the CTA floats on the right off the left text edge, the three pills are bulky and ragged in width, and HONEY ROSEMARY sits close to the bottom edge.
